description: Design note only. Records today's CPU path (getOutputImage -> nativeEncodedDevelop -> developEncoded), the target MediaCodec -> ImageReader -> YUV textures -> shared GLES chain with EncodedColorSpec uniforms (OES is not the main path), the effect on the GLES session and ChainSlots (a new pass-1 variant, slot plan unchanged), the relation to the F1-6 node gates (K11), the independently mergeable steps E0b-2..5, and the risks. Numbers are stated with their source; nothing is implemented.
